title: IPC frame body
description:
The JSON object inside one length-prefixed frame, after the 4-byte big-endian length. This schema covers the BODY only: the length prefix, the 131,072-byte ceiling on it, and the rule that zero length is invalid are framing concerns outside JSON Schema and are asserted by the codec (LOCAL-IPC.md §Framing).

The seven message classes are mutually exclusive, discriminated by the properties present. `ping` and `pong` are included because keepalive is REQUIRED by default for any connection holding an endpoint lease (LOCAL-IPC.md): omitting them made every mandatory exchange invalid under the normative shape.

request_id.description: Unique per connection. Not durable and not a replay cursor.

request.description: A method needing an ungranted capability fails locally with a stable authorization error and is never dispatched to the transport runtime — the refusal happens before the request can reach the network.

allOf.$comment: ok and error are exclusive: a failed response that carried no code would leave the caller guessing.

cancel.description: Advisory. An operation past an irreversible network boundary may complete anyway, which is why the response vocabulary separates CancelledBeforeDispatch from CancellationRaced.

sequence.description: Per IPC connection, for gap detection only. NOT a durable replay cursor: there is no event replay after reconnect.

health.description: The closed set from contracts/TRANSPORT.md §status. A bounded string accepted values like "unknown-state", which consumers cannot branch on safely — and a status field whose vocabulary is open is one a client must treat as untyped text.

connectivity.description: The backend-neutral ConnectivitySummary. Ordinary data-plane clients receive normalized direct/relay state and counts only: raw probe-server identities, relay PeerIds, and relay multiaddrs require a diagnostics or admin capability, and are never inferred as trust (ADR-0035, ADR-0036).

keepalive_nonce.description: The 128-bit CSPRNG keepalive value, canonically encoded (LOCAL-IPC.md suggests unpadded base64url). Like the lease epoch it is deliberately NOT pinned to one encoding: it never crosses the network, so no two implementations must agree on its bytes. It is not authentication, not replay protection for application messages, and not a lease-renewal credential — only an exact echo of the CURRENT outstanding nonce satisfies the probe, and stale, duplicate, or wrong nonces do not reset liveness state.

ping.description: Server to client. At most one is outstanding per connection.

pong.description: Client to server, echoing the nonce exactly. Any other value leaves the probe unsatisfied.
